source.text: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH reigns; let the earth be glad; let [the] many coastlands rejoice.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns; let the earth be glad; \q let [the] many coastlands rejoice.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! Let the earth be glad, \q and the many far-off coastlands celebrate.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! Let the whole earth be happy! \q Let the people on all the faraway islands and shores be glad!

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ; que la terre soit dans l’allégresse ; \q que les îles nombreuses se réjouissent.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! Que la terre soit dans l’allégresse, \q et que les nombreuses îles lointaines soient en fête.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! Que toute la terre soit heureuse ! \q Que les gens de toutes les îles et de toutes les côtes lointaines se réjouissent !

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala; nchi na ifurahi; \q visiwa vingi na vishangilie.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! Nchi na ifurahi, \q na pwani nyingi za mbali zisherehekee.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! Dunia yote na ifurahi! \q Watu wa visiwa vyote vya mbali na pwani zote na washangilie!

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina; alégrese la tierra; \q regocíjense las muchas costas.
es.B: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey! Que la tierra se alegre, \q y que celebren las muchas costas lejanas.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey! ¡Que toda la tierra esté feliz! \q ¡Que se alegre la gente de todas las islas y costas lejanas!

decisions.choice: reigns: is King, has taken the throne
decisions.reason: The verb (malak) with the LORD as subject is the cry of Psalms 93, 96, 97 and 99. The same form was shouted when a new king took the throne (2 Samuel 15:10; 2 Kings 9:13), so it may also mean "has become King": the LORD is acclaimed as King over all the earth.

decisions.choice: coastlands: the lands across the sea
decisions.reason: The word ('iyyim) means islands and coasts, the farthest lands Israel knew, across the Mediterranean (Isaiah 42:10-12).
Balanced and Readable say "is King", the plain sense of the royal cry; Literal keeps "reigns".

source.text: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Cloud and thick darkness [are] around him; righteousness and justice [are the] foundation of his throne.

en.L: Cloud and thick darkness [are] around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q righteousness and justice [are] the foundation of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne.
en.B: Clouds and deep darkness surround {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne is built on what is right and just.
en.R: Thick, dark clouds are all around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q He rules from a throne that rests on fairness and justice.

fr.L: Nuée et obscurité [sont] autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q la justice et le droit [sont] la base de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône.
fr.B: Les nuées et l’obscurité profonde {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent ; \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône est bâti sur la justice et le droit.
fr.R: D’épais nuages sombres {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent. \q Il règne sur un trône qui repose sur la justice et l’équité.

sw.L: Wingu na giza nene [viko] kumzunguka; \q haki na hukumu [ni] msingi wa kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi.
sw.B: Mawingu na giza zito vinamzunguka; \q kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi kimejengwa juu ya haki na hukumu.
sw.R: Mawingu mazito meusi yamemzunguka pande zote. \q Anatawala kutoka kiti cha enzi kilichosimama juu ya haki na hukumu ya kweli.

es.L: Nube y densa oscuridad [hay] alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q la justicia y el derecho [son] el cimiento de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono.
es.B: Nubes y densas tinieblas {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodean; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono está construido sobre lo que es recto y justo.
es.R: Nubes espesas y oscuras están a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor. \q Él gobierna desde un trono que se apoya en la justicia y la rectitud.

decisions.choice: cloud and thick darkness: God at Sinai
decisions.reason: When God came down on Mount Sinai there was cloud and thick darkness (Exodus 19:16; 20:21; Deuteronomy 4:11). Verses 2-5 describe the King's coming in the same way.
The second line repeats 89:15: the King's rule stands on righteousness and justice.

source.text: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Fire before him goes and sets ablaze all around his foes.

en.L: Fire goes before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q and sets ablaze {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} foes all around.
en.B: Fire marches ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q and burns up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies on every side.
en.R: Fire goes ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q It burns up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies all around.

fr.L: Un feu marche devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q et embrase tout autour {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} adversaires.
fr.B: Un feu s’avance devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q et dévore {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis de tous côtés.
fr.R: Un feu va devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Il brûle {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis tout autour.

sw.L: Moto unakwenda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q na kuwateketeza watesi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} pande zote.
sw.B: Moto unatangulia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q na kuwachoma adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kila upande.
sw.R: Moto unatangulia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Unawachoma adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} pande zote.

es.L: Fuego va delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q y abrasa a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} adversarios alrededor.
es.B: El fuego avanza delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \q y consume a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos por todos lados.
es.R: El fuego va delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q Quema a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos por todas partes.

decisions.choice: fire: the sign of God's coming
decisions.reason: Fire goes with the appearing of God, as at Sinai (Exodus 19:18) and in 50:3.
The verb (lihet) is to set on fire, to consume in flame (83:15).

source.text: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: His lightnings light up [the] world; [the] earth sees and trembles.

en.L: His lightnings light up the world; \q the earth sees and trembles.
en.B: The world is lit by the flash of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} lightning; \q the earth sees it and quakes.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} lightning flashes, the whole world is bright. \q The earth sees it and shakes with fear.

fr.L: Ses éclairs illuminent le monde ; \q la terre voit et tremble.
fr.B: Le monde est éclairé par l’éclat de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} éclairs ; \q la terre le voit et frémit.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} éclairs brillent, le monde entier est illuminé. \q La terre le voit et tremble de peur.

sw.L: Umeme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unaangaza ulimwengu; \q nchi inaona na kutetemeka.
sw.B: Ulimwengu unaangazwa na mmweko wa umeme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q nchi inauona na kutetemeka.
sw.R: Umeme {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unapomulika, ulimwengu wote unang'aa. \q Nchi inauona na kutetemeka kwa hofu.

es.L: Sus relámpagos alumbran el mundo; \q la tierra ve y tiembla.
es.B: El mundo se ilumina con el destello de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} relámpagos; \q la tierra lo ve y se estremece.
es.R: Cuando brillan {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} relámpagos, el mundo entero se ilumina. \q La tierra lo ve y tiembla de miedo.

decisions.choice: light up, sees, trembles: a scene told as happening
decisions.reason: The verbs are past forms in Hebrew, but they describe the King's appearing as a scene before the eyes, so they are given in the present.
77:19 uses the same words of the storm at the crossing of the sea: "lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled".

source.text: הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Mountains like wax melt before YHWH, before [the] Lord of all the earth.

en.L: Mountains like wax melt before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q before the Lord of all the earth.
en.B: In the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the mountains soften like wax, \q in the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
en.R: The mountains melt like wax when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes near. \q He is the Lord of the whole earth.

fr.L: Les montagnes comme la cire fondent devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q devant le Seigneur de toute la terre.
fr.B: Devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les montagnes s’amollissent comme la cire, \q devant le Seigneur de toute la terre.
fr.R: Les montagnes fondent comme de la cire quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’approche. \q Il est le Seigneur de toute la terre.

sw.L: Milima inayeyuka kama nta mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mbele za Bwana wa dunia yote.
sw.B: Mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} milima inalainika kama nta, \q mbele za Bwana wa dunia nzima.
sw.R: Milima inayeyuka kama nta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapokaribia. \q Yeye ndiye Bwana wa dunia nzima.

es.L: Los montes como cera se derriten delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q delante del Señor de toda la tierra.
es.B: En la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} los montes se ablandan como cera, \q en la presencia del Señor de toda la tierra.
es.R: Los montes se derriten como cera cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se acerca. \q Él es el Señor de toda la tierra.

decisions.reason: The word ('adon) is master or lord. "The Lord of all the earth" is a title from the crossing of the Jordan (Joshua 3:11, 13).
Micah 1:3-4 also pictures the mountains melting like wax when the LORD comes.
Readable says the mountains melt at God's coming; the Hebrew "from before" implies it.

source.text: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל־הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.

en.L: The heavens declare {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} righteousness, \q and all the peoples see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.B: The skies announce that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is righteous, \q and every people sees {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.R: The sky tells everyone that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does what is right. \q People of every nation see how glorious {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is.

fr.L: Les cieux annoncent {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} justice, \q et tous les peuples voient {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.B: Les cieux proclament qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est juste, \q et chaque peuple voit {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.R: Le ciel dit à tous qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait ce qui est juste. \q Les gens de toutes les nations voient combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est glorieux.

sw.L: Mbingu zinatangaza haki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na mataifa yote yanaona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Anga zinatangaza kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwenye haki, \q na kila taifa linaona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Anga linawaambia wote kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hutenda yaliyo ya haki. \q Watu wa kila taifa wanaona jinsi alivyo mtukufu.

es.L: Los cielos anuncian {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} justicia, \q y todos los pueblos ven {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.B: Los cielos proclaman que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es justo, \q y cada pueblo ve {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.R: El cielo le dice a todo el mundo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace lo que es justo. \q La gente de todas las naciones ve lo glorioso que es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

decisions.reason: 50:6 has the same words, "the heavens declare his righteousness"; 19:2 has the heavens telling God's glory.
The word (tsedeq) is God's rightness, seen in the way he rules and judges.

source.text: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀כָּל־עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֝וֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Let all who serve an image be ashamed, those who boast in the worthless idols; bow down to him, all gods.

en.L: Let all who serve a carved image be put to shame, \q who boast in worthless idols; \q bow down to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all gods.
en.B: Let everyone who serves carved idols be disgraced, \q all who brag about worthless gods; \q bow down before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all you gods!
en.R: People who worship statues of gods should be ashamed. \q They boast about idols that are worth nothing. \q Every so-called god must bow down to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Qu’ils soient couverts de honte, tous ceux qui servent une image taillée, \q qui se glorifient des idoles de néant ; \q prosternez-vous devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, vous tous les dieux.
fr.B: Honte à tous ceux qui servent des idoles taillées, \q à tous ceux qui se vantent de dieux qui ne sont rien ; \q inclinez-vous devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, vous tous les dieux !
fr.R: Ceux qui adorent des statues de dieux devraient avoir honte. \q Ils se vantent d’idoles qui ne valent rien. \q Tous ces prétendus dieux doivent s’incliner devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !

sw.L: Wote watumikiao sanamu ya kuchonga na waaibike, \q wanaojisifu kwa vinyago visivyo na kitu; \q msujudieni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, enyi miungu yote.
sw.B: Kila anayetumikia sanamu za kuchonga na aaibishwe, \q wote wanaojigamba kwa miungu isiyo na thamani; \q inameni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, enyi miungu yote!
sw.R: Watu wanaoabudu sanamu za miungu wanapaswa kuona aibu. \q Wanajisifu kwa sanamu zisizo na thamani yoyote. \q Kila kitu kiitwacho mungu lazima kimsujudie!

es.L: Avergüéncense todos los que sirven a una imagen tallada, \q los que se jactan de los ídolos sin valor; \q {{plural_you:póstrense|postraos}} ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, todos los dioses.
es.B: Que queden en vergüenza todos los que sirven a ídolos tallados, \q todos los que presumen de dioses sin valor; \q ¡{{plural_you:póstrense|postraos}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, dioses!
es.R: Los que adoran estatuas de dioses deberían avergonzarse. \q Presumen de ídolos que no valen nada. \q ¡Todo supuesto dios tiene que inclinarse ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!

decisions.reason: The verb may be a wish ("let them be ashamed") or a statement ("they are put to shame"). Either way the appearing of the true King shows up the idols.
The word ('elilim) is the one of 96:5, a play on the word for gods.
The ancient Greek translation reads "bow down to him, all his angels". Hebrews 1:6 uses words like these of the angels worshiping God's Son.
Readable keeps the call but makes clear these gods are not rivals (95:3).

source.text: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח׀צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Zion hears and rejoices, and [the] daughters of Judah are glad because of your judgments, YHWH.

en.L: Zion hears and is glad, \q and the daughters of Judah rejoice \q because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Zion hears of it and is filled with joy; \q the towns of Judah celebrate \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} acts of justice, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the people of Jerusalem hear how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge, and they are happy. \q The towns of Judah are glad because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do what is right.

fr.L: Sion entend et se réjouit, \q et les filles de Juda sont dans l’allégresse \q à cause de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Sion l’apprend et se remplit de joie ; \q les villes de Juda célèbrent \q {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} actes de justice, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les habitants de Jérusalem apprennent comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juges, et ils sont heureux. \q Les villes de Juda se réjouissent parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais ce qui est juste.

sw.L: Sayuni inasikia na kufurahi, \q na binti za Yuda wanashangilia \q kwa sababu ya hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Sayuni inasikia habari hiyo na kujaa furaha; \q miji ya Yuda inasherehekea \q matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya haki, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu wa Yerusalemu wanasikia jinsi unavyohukumu, nao wanafurahi. \q Miji ya Yuda inashangilia kwa sababu unatenda yaliyo ya haki.

es.L: Oye Sion y se alegra, \q y las hijas de Judá se regocijan \q a causa de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} juicios, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Sion lo oye y se llena de gozo; \q los pueblos de Judá celebran \q {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} actos de justicia, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, la gente de Jerusalén oye cómo juzgas, y está feliz. \q Los pueblos de Judá se alegran porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces lo que es justo.

decisions.choice: the daughters of Judah: the towns of Judah
decisions.reason: A city's "daughters" are often its villages (Numbers 21:25). It may also mean the women of Judah, who sang at victories (1 Samuel 18:6).
The line repeats 48:12. Zion and Judah are glad because God's judgments have put down his enemies.
See m1.
Readable names the city and its people.

decisions.choice: "binti za Yuda" (the daughters of Judah) at Literal; "miji ya Yuda" (the towns of Judah) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: In Hebrew a country's "daughters" are its towns; Literal keeps the picture and the other levels say what it means, as the English does.

source.text: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For you, YHWH, [are] Most High over all the earth; exceedingly you are exalted above all gods.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [are] Most High over all the earth; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are exalted far above all gods.
en.B: For it is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, who are Most High over the whole earth; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are lifted far above every god.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the God who is above all, ruling over the whole earth. \q You are far, far greater than any god.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] le Très-Haut sur toute la terre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es élevé bien au-dessus de tous les dieux.
fr.B: Car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui es le Très-Haut sur toute la terre ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es placé bien au-dessus de tout dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} règnes sur toute la terre. \q Tu es bien, bien plus grand que n’importe quel dieu.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [ndiwe] Aliye Juu Kabisa juu ya dunia yote; \q umetukuzwa juu sana kuliko miungu yote.
sw.B: Kwa maana ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uliye Juu Kabisa juu ya dunia nzima; \q umeinuliwa juu sana ya kila mungu.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Mungu aliye juu ya wote, unayetawala dunia nzima. \q Wewe ni mkuu sana kuliko mungu yeyote.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [eres] Altísimo sobre toda la tierra; \q eres muy exaltado sobre todos los dioses.
es.B: Porque eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Altísimo sobre toda la tierra; \q estás muy por encima de todo dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Dios que está por encima de todo y gobierna toda la tierra. \q Eres mucho, mucho más grande que cualquier dios.

decisions.reason: The title ('Elyon) names God as the highest over all (Genesis 14:19; 7:18).
The verb ('alah) is to go up; here God is raised high above every power.

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title means (m1).

source.text: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵרנַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [You who] love YHWH, hate evil! He guards [the] lives of his faithful ones; from [the] hand of [the] wicked he delivers them.

en.L: You who love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, hate evil! \q He guards the souls of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful ones; \q from the hand of the wicked {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delivers them.
en.B: All who love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, hate what is evil! \q He watches over the lives of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful people \q and rescues them from the power of the wicked.
en.R: If you love {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, hate what is wrong! \q He protects the lives of people who are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q He saves them from the power of evil people.

fr.L: Vous qui aimez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, haïssez le mal ! \q Il garde les âmes de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles ; \q de la main des méchants {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les délivre.
fr.B: Vous tous qui aimez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, haïssez ce qui est mal ! \q Il veille sur la vie de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles \q et les arrache au pouvoir des méchants.
fr.R: Si vous aimez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, détestez ce qui est mal ! \q Il protège la vie de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont fidèles. \q Il les sauve du pouvoir des gens mauvais.

sw.L: Ninyi mmpendao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, chukieni uovu! \q Yeye huzilinda nafsi za waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q kutoka mkononi mwa waovu huwaokoa.
sw.B: Ninyi nyote mnaompenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yachukieni maovu! \q Yeye huyalinda maisha ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waaminifu \q na kuwaokoa kutoka katika nguvu za waovu.
sw.R: Kama mnampenda {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, chukieni yaliyo mabaya! \q Yeye hulinda maisha ya watu walio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \q Huwaokoa kutoka katika nguvu za watu waovu.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} los que {{plural_you:aman|amáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:aborrezcan|aborreced}} el mal! \q Él guarda las almas de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} fieles; \q de la mano de los malvados los libra.
es.B: ¡Todos los que {{plural_you:aman|amáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:aborrezcan|aborreced}} lo malo! \q Él cuida la vida de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo fiel \q y los rescata del poder de los malvados.
es.R: ¡Si {{plural_you:aman|amáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:odien|odiad}} lo que es malo! \q Él protege la vida de los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} son fieles. \q Los salva del poder de la gente malvada.

decisions.choice: faithful ones: people loyal to God
decisions.reason: The word (chasid) comes from chesed: those who answer God's loyal love with loyalty.

decisions.choice: the hand of the wicked: their power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and control.
The word (nefesh) is the whole living self; Literal says "souls", Balanced and Readable "lives", as the conventions allow.

records.literal_gloss: Light [is] sown for the righteous and for [the] upright of heart joy.

en.L: Light [is] sown for the righteous, \q and for the upright in heart, joy.
en.B: Light is scattered like seed for the righteous, \q and joy for those whose hearts are true.
en.R: God scatters light like seeds for people who do what is right. \q He plants joy for people whose hearts are honest.

fr.L: La lumière [est] semée pour le juste, \q et pour ceux qui ont le cœur droit, la joie.
fr.B: La lumière est répandue comme une semence pour le juste, \q et la joie pour ceux dont le cœur est sincère.
fr.R: Dieu sème la lumière comme des graines pour ceux qui font ce qui est juste. \q Il plante la joie pour ceux dont le cœur est honnête.

sw.L: Nuru imepandwa kwa ajili ya mwenye haki, \q na kwa wanyofu wa moyo, furaha.
sw.B: Nuru imetawanywa kama mbegu kwa ajili ya wenye haki, \q na furaha kwa wale ambao mioyo yao ni ya kweli.
sw.R: Mungu hutawanya nuru kama mbegu kwa ajili ya watu wanaotenda haki. \q Hupanda furaha kwa ajili ya watu wenye mioyo minyofu.

es.L: Luz [está] sembrada para el justo, \q y para los rectos de corazón, alegría.
es.B: La luz se esparce como semilla para el justo, \q y la alegría para los de corazón sincero.
es.R: Dios esparce luz como semillas para los que hacen lo que es justo. \q Siembra alegría para los que tienen un corazón honesto.

decisions.choice: sown: as the Hebrew text reads
alternatives: dawns (one Hebrew manuscript and the ancient translations)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "sown" (zarua'). A few Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient translations read "dawns" or "rises" (zarach), a difference of one letter, as in 112:4. "Sown" makes sense: light is scattered like seed and will spring up.
Light stands for God's favor, life and rescue (27:1; 36:10).
Readable names who sows the light, which the passive implies.

source.text: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Rejoice, righteous [ones], in YHWH, and give thanks to [the] remembrance of his holiness.

en.L: Rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you righteous, \q and give thanks to the remembrance of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness.
en.B: Be glad in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you righteous people, \q and thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, calling {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name to mind.
en.R: You people who do what is right, be happy because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and remember that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is holy.

fr.L: Réjouissez-vous {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}}, vous les justes, \q et rendez grâce au souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté.
fr.B: Soyez dans la joie à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous les justes, \q et rendez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} grâce en vous rappelant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom.
fr.R: Vous qui faites ce qui est juste, réjouissez-vous à cause {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! \q Remerciez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} et souvenez-vous qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est saint.

sw.L: Furahini katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi wenye haki, \q na toeni shukrani kwa ukumbusho wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Furahini katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watu wenye haki, \q na mshukuruni, mkilikumbuka jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu.
sw.R: Enyi watu mnaotenda haki, furahini kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Mshukuruni na kukumbuka kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mtakatifu.

es.L: {{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, justos, \q y {{plural_you:den|dad}} gracias al recuerdo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Gócense|Gozaos}} en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, gente justa, \q y {{plural_you:denle|dadle}} gracias, trayendo a la memoria {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, los que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} lo que es justo, ¡{{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q {{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} gracias y {{plural_you:recuerden|recordad}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es santo.

decisions.choice: remembrance: the name by which God is remembered
decisions.reason: The word (zekher) is the name that keeps someone in memory (Exodus 3:15). The line repeats 30:5.

decisions.choice: the righteous: people who do what is right
decisions.reason: The word (tsaddiqim) is those who live rightly before God, as in verse 11.
